name: Landmarks of the Ancient Kingdom of Saba, Marib
description: Seven archaeological sites around Marib in eastern Yemen preserve the heart of the Kingdom of Saba, which grew rich by controlling much of the Arabian incense route. Among the ruins are temples, city ramparts and the remains of a vast irrigation network that created the largest ancient man-made oasis. Listed in 2023, the sites are also on the Danger List because of Yemen's civil war.
